site.name: MboteData

home.heroSubtitle: Compare eSIM data plans from trusted networks, then pay however suits you — a Lightning wallet, or straight from your mobile money balance.

home.step2Body: Pay with a Bitcoin Lightning wallet, or with M-Pesa / mobile money via Machankura — no bank card needed.
home.step3Body: Your eSIM QR code and setup instructions arrive as soon as payment is confirmed.
